## Problem / motivation
What is painful or missing today? Who does it help?

## Proposed solution

## Alternatives considered
What other approaches did you think about, and why is this one better?

- [ ] other: ___

- [ ] This feature can be built with no paid API, no account sign-up, and no scraping of third-party sites
